title: What Happens If You NEVER Sleep? (Day by Day)
description:
What happens if you never sleep? Hour by hour, then day by day, all the way to day eleven: the record nobody is allowed to try anymore.

Our hero decides to be the champion of NOT sleeping (his cat is the champion of sleeping). At hour 17 his brain tests like it's had a few drinks, at hour 30 bits of it fall asleep while he's awake, and by day three the coat on the door turns its head. Then the real story: Randy Gardner, 17, who stayed awake for 11 days in 1964, and what happened to the animals that went further.

An animated short film from CurioPulse. Every picture is drawn in code.

0:00 What if you never sleep?
0:20 Hour 16: the pile in your brain
0:50 Hour 24: the false sunrise
1:15 Hour 30: microsleeps

2:11 Day 11: the real record
